meta.title: Painting Day at School
meta.textType: time: the hours of the day

paragraphs: Today is Painting Day at school. I am May. Teacher Kim writes our day on the board. It is a fun day. At eight o'clock, we sit in the classroom. At nine o'clock, we paint a big picture. We have paint and paper. Lily paints the sea. Leo paints a funny monster. I paint a house and a tree. Painting is fun!

At ten o'clock, we have fruit and lemonade. Teacher Kim has a green kiwi and a yellow lemon. Leo asks, "Can I have a kiwi?" "Yes, you can," says Teacher Kim. Lily says, "The lemonade is very good!" Leo smiles. We drink the lemonade.

At eleven o'clock, we look at the paintings. This part is my house. That part is my tree. I like my picture. At twelve o'clock, we have lunch. Teacher Kim asks, "Which painting is your favorite?" I say, "Lily's sea!" Lily is very happy. We are happy.
